snippet.title: Cyber Daisenryaku: Shutsugeki! Harukatai | PS1 | Ultra HD 4K/60fps | PREVIEW | Movie Gameplay Sample
snippet.description:
This is intro and gameplay for Cyber Daisenryaku: Shutsugeki! Harukatai for Playstation. Cyber Daisenryaku: Shutsugeki! Harukatai Walkthrough Gameplay Full Game Part 1 includes the Intro, Review, Cyber Daisenryaku: Shutsugeki! Harukatai Single Player No Commentary Story Campaign for Playstation. Cyber Daisenryaku: Shutsugeki! Harukatai full game is available on following systems/consoles/platforms: PlayStation, PS1

DISCLAIMER:
This is 4K ULTRA HD presentation of original Playstation graphics and game appearance captured. It is done this way to preserve original game look through modern footage. No enhancement or smoothing was used.

Cyber Daisenryaku is a Tactical RPG game in which the player will control a high school student that is training for the Cyber Battles and will start an adventure in which he will have to use all that he had learned in the trainings to win in the Cyber Battles that he will face.

The game mode features a story part in first person perspective with 2d cartoon graphics and the battle part in a 2d third person perspective that features a 3D view in the part of the battle attacks.
